observations: Defaults to the .NET 10 set; NetVersion 9 is accepted as an alias for 10, and NetVersion 4 selects the other publisher path.
Self-update runs by default from the mutable download.ericzimmermanstools.com Get-ZimmermanTools.zip route; -NoUpdate disables it, and a .git directory beside the running script prevents replacement.
Discovers ZIP/TXT links by regex from the live tools.ericzimmerman.github.io page, excludes KAPE and All archives, and selects up to six concurrent conditional GETs.
Stores HTTP ETag values in the CSV column named SHA1; the value is not a payload SHA-1 or SHA-256 verification.

Extracts ZIP contents over existing destination files. The current extractor checks destination containment against zip-slip paths, but overwrite behavior remains and no member allowlist, archive digest, or signature verification is present.
-Sync recursively finds EvtxECmd, SQLECmd, and RECmd executables under Dest and executes each with --sync; this is a separate code-execution action and was not run.

LICENSE.note: The copyright year is future-dated relative to this review. Preserve the upstream notice if adapting this helper; this observation is not a legal or migration gate.
